thread:
Priya: quick summary of ember-summarizer-7b quant sweeps. did FP16 vs INT6 vs INT4 on our email/summaries slice. short take: INT4 cuts cost ~48% vs FP16, rouge-l drops 1.7 pts on long emails (>800 tokens), hallucination rate tiny but noticeable on tables.

Priya: compact table:
```
Variant | cost / 1k tokens | rouge-l | halluc rate (pct) | p50 latency
FP16    | $2.60            | 65.4    | 0.9%             | 140ms
INT6    | $1.97 (-24%)     | 64.9    | 1.0%             | 128ms
INT4    | $1.35 (-48%)     | 63.7    | 1.8%             | 120ms
```

Dan: thanks. what's "halluc rate" definition here?

Priya: percent of outputs failing our factual-checker on table/citation checks. mainly when source has many numbers.

Jorge: curious about user-visible regressions. is 1.7 rouge-l points a showstopper for drafts or only for final-summary flows?

Priya: for quick previews it's fine. for legal/contract summaries it's unacceptable.

Mei (product): product asks: can we do hybrid routing? maybe INT4 for preview, INT6 for detailed, FP16 for legal. also need a rollback SLA if we see regression in production.

Nikhil: propose traffic mix: preview (40%): INT4, standard (50%): INT6, sensitive (10%): FP16. estimated blended cost = 0.4*1.35 + 0.5*1.97 + 0.1*2.60 = $1.74/1k (~33% savings).

Clara: ops notes: INT4 reduces KV & model mem -> +25% QPS per-GPU. but tail latency risk on long sequences; suggest set kvcache TTL=10s and max-batch=6 for longform routes.

Priya: monitoring plan: add these slices to eval pipeline: short (<128), medium (128-800), long (>800), tables. track rouge-l, halluc rate, and a new metric: cost-per-acceptable-summary (cost / pct_pass).

Mei (product): requirement: auto-rollback if long-slice rouge-l drops >1.0 pt or halluc rate increases >0.5%. also add user-telemetry for "summary edit rate" as leading indicator.

Dan: can we run a 48h canary on staging -> then 72h on 10% production previews?

Priya: plan: staging canary 48h (all slices), then prod preview canary 72h at 10% traffic, then ramp if no alerts. I'll publish a short scorecard at the end of each window.

OpsBot: deploy job created: /deploy ember-summarizer-7b-int4 canary -> env=staging by Priya

Clara: I'll update the model profile flags (quantized=true, expected_mem_delta=-25%). Also add per-variant tagging for billing routes.

Nikhil: adding cost-per-acceptable-summary to dashboard, will emit alert when cost diverges +10% vs baseline or pass-rate drops 1.0% absolute.

Priya: one more note: int4 failure cases are concentrated on table extraction; suggestion: route table-heavy prompts to INT6 until we feel confident.

Mei (product): perfect. I'll prep guidance for GTN + copy for release notes (call out preview vs final tiers).

Priya: thanks everyone. I'll kick off the staging canary now and post results.

[thread end]
